HEXAGHOST-WHEEL_FTUE.title: The Ghostflame Wheel
HEXAGHOST-WHEEL_FTUE.description:
The active Ghostflame sits on top.
Fulfill its condition to [gold]Ignite[/gold] the flame and activate its effect.
At the end of your turn, if the active Ghostflame is Ignited, the wheel [gold]Advances[/gold] to the next flame.
